name: Elektrichka Sapsan
original_name: エレクトリーチカ・サプサン
source:
A foreign exchange student from Russia who is nicknamed Leche. With a polite tone and a cool impression, she has a mysterious side about her.
Even though its not true, Leche looks emotionally unstable when you first meet her, therefore she has not been able to make friends and has been living a lonely life.
Leche very passionate about things she likes. A Japanophile who even sticks out in her home country. Leche is a history buff, especially about the warring states era, therefore she ended up signing up to study here. When she talks about the famous generals from that era, her eyes light up. For her future prospects, she wants to live and work in Japan.
